reviews.text: I’ve been using Mixsoon Bean Cream daily for a few weeks now and I’m genuinely impressed! The texture is rich and creamy but absorbs nicely without feeling greasy. It keeps my skin hydrated all day, even in dry weather, and I noticed that my skin feels softer and smoother after just a few uses. I also love that it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin — no redness or breakouts at all. A little goes a long way, so the jar lasts quite a while. Overall, a fantastic moisturizer that delivers deep hydration and comfort — will definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 我而家日日都用緊 Mixsoon Bean Cream，用咗幾個星期，真心覺得好滿意！質感豐厚幼滑，但吸收得好好，完全唔覺油笠。喺乾燥天氣都可以全日 keep 住皮膚水分，用咗幾次之後皮膚明顯更加柔軟滑溜。我都好鍾意佢完全唔刺激我呢種敏感肌——冇泛紅、冇爆瘡。少量已經夠用，所以一罐可以用好耐。整體嚟講係一款非常出色嘅保濕霜，做到深層滋潤又舒服——一定會回購！

reviews.text: I recently added Mixsoon Bean Cream to my skincare routine and really like how it gives deep hydration without feeling greasy. My skin felt smoother and more nourished after just a few uses. Great for daily use, especially before bedtime when my skin needs a little extra care.
reviews.zh: 我最近將 Mixsoon Bean Cream 加入護膚程序，佢深層保濕得嚟又唔會覺得油笠。用咗幾次之後皮膚明顯更加滑，皮膚亦都更加有養分。非常適合日日用，尤其夜晚瞓覺前想皮膚有多啲護理嗰陣。

reviews.text: OMG ITS SO SO GOOD!!! YOU NEED TO BUY THIS. I have extremely dry and dehydrated skin where I even get eczema. However this is such a lovely and thick cream but doesn’t feel heavy at all. Amazing under makeup as well and will stop there being any cakey-ness due to the hydration the cream provides. I’m on my 7th tub now. Wish there was a bigger size.
reviews.zh: OMG 真係超級好用！！！你一定要買。我皮膚極度乾燥又缺水，仲會出濕疹。但呢款霜質地厚潤但完全唔覺得重。化妝前用好好，因為呢款霜嘅保濕力可以避免出現卡粉。我已經用緊第 7 罐。好想有大瓶裝。

reviews.text: Seriously the best moisturizer ever—hydrates my skin so well and leaves it with such a glowy, glass-like finish that I never thought was possible on my skin. No other moisturizer that I’ve tried has even gotten close. I also have acne prone skin and I believe my acne has gotten significantly better since using this moisturizer. I will be using this for a very long time!
reviews.zh: 認真講，係我用過最好嘅保濕霜——保濕效果一流，用完皮膚有一種好有光澤、似玻璃肌嘅妝效，呢種效果我從來冇諗過自己皮膚都可以做到。其他保濕霜完全冇得比。我皮膚係容易生暗瘡嘅，但自從用咗呢款保濕霜之後，暗瘡明顯改善咗好多。我會繼續用好耐！

reviews.text: This is my favorite deep moisturizer. It goes on so smooth and provides a lot of moisture that keeps hydrating for hours. I really love this in the winter when the air is dry and my skin gets even drier. The cream is rich and has a very light pleasant scent (but not perfume). It goes on so nicely and keeps my skin feeling soft for many hours. This is definitely my favorite cream to use during the dry winter months. Also, I have pretty sensitive skin but this doesn't irritate me at all!
reviews.zh: 呢款係我最鍾意嘅深層保濕霜。搽上去好滑，提供好多水分，可以保濕幾個鐘。冬天空氣乾燥、皮膚更加乾嘅時候，我特別鍾意用。霜嘅質地豐厚，有好淡好清香嘅味道（但唔係香水味）。搽起上嚟好舒服，皮膚幾個鐘都 keep 住柔軟。冬天乾燥嗰幾個月絕對係我嘅首選面霜。仲有，我皮膚都幾敏感，但完全冇刺激到我！

reviews.text:
Second time purchasing this cream and I love it doesn’t leave me feeling greasy and once I put it on at night it and into the morning my face still feels moisturized and not dry. Only downside is I wish the it came in a bigger container 
Skin type :Oily/combo
reviews.zh:
第二次回購呢款面霜，我好鍾意佢唔會令我覺得油笠，夜晚搽完去到第二朝成塊面都仲係保濕，唔會乾。唯一缺點係好想有大支裝。
膚質：油性/混合性

reviews.text: Perhaps it’s due to the humidity of where I live but this cream took a while to absorb (longer than the Laniege hydro bank cream). Consistency was also a lot thicker than I anticipated and wasn’t as watery. I was really excited about this product as i read many good reviews about it but i ended up getting a lot of whiteheads and under the skin bumps? I have combination skin so maybe this product is not the best for those with a similar skin type to me :(
reviews.zh: 可能係因為我住嗰度比較潮濕，呢款面霜吸收得好慢（比起 Laniege 水庫霜仲要耐）。質感亦都比我想像中厚，冇預期咁水。我本來對呢款產品好有期望，因為睇過好多好評，但用完之後爆咗好多白頭同埋皮膚底層嘅粒粒？我係混合性皮膚，所以可能呢款產品唔太適合類似膚質嘅人 :(

reviews.text: I bought this because I saw an influencer on Tiktok recommended it and didn't do any more research on it (oops). When I first opened it, it was super gooey and sticky. I was quite hesitant to use it because I absolutely hate thick moisturizers/creams. But to my surprised, it melts into my skin so well!! I love it sooo much. I have pretty dry skin so this helps tremendously!
reviews.zh: 我買呢款係因為喺 Tiktok 見到有網紅推薦，冇再深入做 research（伏咗）。第一次打開嘅時候，成塊霜超級黏笠。我本身好怕用厚身嘅保濕霜/面霜，所以當時都幾猶豫。但令我意外嘅係，佢喺皮膚上推開得好順！我超鍾意。我皮膚偏乾，呢款幫到我好多！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
